animation-timing.description: Ink uses React render cycles which may have different timing than Blessed's immediate updates
animation-timing.notes: This is expected due to the different rendering architectures

scroll-physics.description: Scroll acceleration and smoothing may differ between implementations
scroll-physics.notes: Should be fixed to ensure consistent user experience

focus-indicators.description: Focus styling might render slightly differently
focus-indicators.notes: Minor visual differences in focus indicators are acceptable

color-rendering.description: Terminal color interpretation may vary slightly

cursor-positioning.description: Cursor position tracking may have minor differences
cursor-positioning.notes: As long as input handling works correctly
